svg.aria-label: Jacob LeCoq. A roguelike map: @ walks from Bayer through Liatrio to Adobe, followed by a pet rooster.
svg.text: Welcome, Jacob. You start at Bayer with a 22-app Nx monorepo and a Terraform map.
You enter Liatrio and build an AI software factory. The PRs start fixing themselves.
You arrive at Adobe. The agents here are friendly.
Jacob the Engineer St:Go Dx:TypeScript In:Rust Wis:agents
Dlvl:3 Adobe Pet:rooster HP:caffeinated T:2016 Lafayette, LA
